reviews.review: That was a long jurney. Finally I completed every achievements and now I can say that this is a wonderful game, from the beginning to the end. Maybe sometimes can be hard and frustrating, but is definitively a game that made me entertained, challenged and even joyful. I'm proud to have it in my library.

I love the Risk of Rain games! I have bought both games 4 times. On Switch and on Steam including all RoR2 Dlcs because i love the game. I have spent hundreds of hours on RoR... What i cant seem to phatom and literally my only issue is how the Risk of Rain on steam DOES NOT support PS4 controllers or any other PC controller... Im in need of an update to fully enjoy Risk of Rain as a steam purchase. 

Overall made with love!
-A Loving Fan

I'm making a review of this now realising i never had when i played this back in 2016 when i first played it, but this game was the start of one of my favourite game series of all time, and even now the original game still holds up just as good as RoR2 and Returns, and probably even better than a lot of triple A titles that come out nowadays as well, I highly reccomend trying any of the RoR games if you get the chance!

I pirated that game 12 years ago and went on to kill the boars with Acrid on that one glitched spot. I remember leaving a pin on my keyboard so Acrid could keep shooting with the range 1 in 4 chance thing stacked 4 times over thus killing thousands of boars. In the morning my pc would lag for like 20 minutes while I'd pick up that loot. Good times. Then I was introduced to steam and bought it. Same stuff, only on steam.

This game is good. Although old, it still holds up, take it from a boomer.
